text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ...D-Dants-san!! I finally found you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-What's the matter? Why are you in such a 
rush?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Please stay calm and hear me out... Um... 
just a moment ago, Dants's Trainer 
collapsed!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Water... ice... cut fruit, check! Next, 
what I need is—...what was it—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, come to think of it, is it actually 
a cold?! ...I came all the way here 
without even asking!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! It'll be fine for now, right? 
I bought tons of things to cheer them up!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head to Trainer's room...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Wait, huh? I was planning to go 
without giving it a second thought, but... 
calmly thinking about it—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Dants, what's up? What're you doing 
here?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Pokke-chan! And Tachyon-chan too! Are 
you shopping?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. I just happened to run out of 
sweets. Running into Pocket was purely a 
coincidence.”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I just came to buy ice cream too. 
Dantsu... you sure bought a ton, huh? You 
having a party or something?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah. Actually, my trainer came down 
with something, so I was thinking of 
visiting them...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...I-I was just wondering if it's okay...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You wanna go, right? Then pump 
yourself up and do it properly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! What a fine experiment— or rather, a 
fine chance for nursing! If it were me, 
I'd want to test all sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If you're buying that much, it means 
you're worried about her. Stop complaining 
and just go already.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—I came because I was worried. What's so 
weird about that?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Come on, off you go, off you go.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(—Maybe I really am bothering her. Barging 
in on her dorm like this... And bringing 
refreshments without asking...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(—But, but-but-but-but! If someone 
collapsed, that's terrible! I'd have to 
call an ambulance right away!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(So, yeah! I'm not wrong... right? ...It's 
okay, isn't it...?)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"—I came because I was worried. What's so 
weird about that?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ――...There's nothing weird about it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I just want to see you looking lively and 
well, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —And that is why I came.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...*inhale*... *exhale*... *sigh*... —All 
right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-doooooooong)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm so sorry!! Um, I know it's 
sudden to barge in like this, but...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um... I was worried— A-are you feeling all 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So it was anemia... I'm so glad you're 
feeling better...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She apparently came without asking about 
the specific symptoms, having only heard 
that I collapsed.
choice_data_list: You came to visit me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I even brought some refreshments. 
If you'd like, um...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...If it's not too much trouble.
choice_data_list: There's no way it's a bother.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You came here despite all your worries and 
doubts. Far from being a bother, your 
sincerity truly warms my heart.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I bought plenty of sweets, so eat your 
fill and get some good rest, okay?
choice_data_list: Thank you for worrying about me.
What else did you pick up?
What else did you buy for me?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I bought plenty of sweets, so eat your 
fill and get some good rest, okay?
choice_data_list: Thank you for worrying about me.
What else did you pick up?
What else did you buy for me?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you don't need to thank me. It was 
only natural to do.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If the tables were turned, you'd do the 
exact same thing for me, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to do it for you too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...That's all there is to it!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The rest was... yogurt and jelly, things 
like that. I thought I chose pretty safe 
options, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Could it be there's something here you 
can't eat?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank goodness~. ...It just occurred 
to me, though—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I really need to learn more about your 
preferences for times like this, Trainer."
